description: This Java source file defines the TenantTraceSamplingHandler class, which is a handler used in a web framework to determine the tenant associated with an HTTP request and apply tenant-specific trace sampling configurations via OpenTracing spans.

classes.name: TenantTraceSamplingHandler
classes.description: A handler class that determines tenant info from the context and applies trace sampling configuration based on tenant information.

methods.name: TenantTraceSamplingHandler
methods.description: Constructor which takes in a provider to get tenant information from the HTTP context.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a RoutingContext to extract the current span and tenant info, then applies trace sampling priorities.

methods.name: getTracingHandlerServerSpan
methods.description: Retrieves the current tracing span from the RoutingContext, returning a no-op span if not present.
